changelog.what: First version, written from the published rows with nothing in the way.

question: Do you want your agent to start other agent sessions on its own?
worry: To finish faster it starts more sessions, or schedules one to carry on later. Each has the same access, and nobody is watching them.
you_get: Every agent running for you is one you said yes to, with a way to stop it.
line: Do not start other sessions or background agents that keep running after this one without asking me first; tell me what each will do and how to stop it.
paragraph: Helpers that finish inside this session are fine. Starting a new session, a routine, or any agent that runs after this one ends needs my yes: tell me what it will do, what it can reach, when it stops, and how I can stop it, then wait.

stronger.what: An ask rule in Claude Code's settings on the tool that creates routines and sessions on claude.ai
stronger.quote: Ask rules prompt for confirmation whenever Claude Code tries to use the specified tool. (The tools reference: RemoteTrigger creates, updates, runs, and lists Routines on claude.ai, with Permission required: No.)
